question: Should transient tool progress become a permanent public reply-payload intent distinct from the existing status-notice contract?
rationale: The implementation and proof establish the behavior, but adding reusable Plugin SDK semantics is a long-term API decision requiring owner intent.

options.title: Approve Typed Progress Intent
options.body: Keep the generic transient-only kind and predicate, document producer and channel obligations, and merge with the existing lifecycle coverage.

options.title: Extend Status Notices
options.body: Represent tool progress as an owner-approved subtype of the existing transient notice contract while preserving the Slack behavior.

options.title: Keep the Seam Private
options.body: Redesign the portable presentation boundary so Slack receives typed intent without adding these public reply-payload exports.

recommendation.title: Approve Typed Progress Intent
recommendation.body: Keep the generic transient-only kind and predicate, document producer and channel obligations, and merge with the existing lifecycle coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest recent history across the public reply-payload contract and the affected Slack and Codex paths.
